label: Fires at GO after an unrewarded rare a2->S1 trial, stronger the more S2 looks good.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * belief_lo
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * belief_cover
explanation: Silent at D1 and D2. At GO it is essentially an indicator of the previous trial being a2 -> S1 (rare) unrewarded, the model-based stay-on-a2 case; this alone gives dev R^2 beyond timing 0.61. Its magnitude in that context grows as the ideal-observer belief favours S2 (negative belief_lo), i.e. after runs of a2 choices where S1 keeps failing (dev 0.63). Outside this context it is near zero regardless of belief. The free fit (trial-before reward/action/state, belief_cover, global belief) adds almost nothing (dev 0.634). Remaining error is mostly windows where the feature is unexpectedly off (0) despite the pattern, which no observed cue tested predicts; it is near-binary in magnitude (~2.5-2.9 when on).

issues: The claims hold up. The indicator alone scores test 0.592 and adding belief_lo gives 0.614. The fitted belief_lo weight is -0.48, so the feature does fire harder when S2 looks good. Belief on the probability scale does a little worse (0.608).
The feature is silent at D1 and D2: the residual tables are exactly 0 there. At GO, every other previous-trial pattern sits at about -0.17 (the baseline's offset), and after 'a2 S1 u' it is +1.63.

None of the extra terms adds anything meaningful on test: belief_cover 0.615, tv('action',-2)==2 0.614, tv('reward',-2)==0 0.617, this-step action==2 0.614, hidden good state 0.614, since_rev 0.616. An episode-position interaction (ep_trial) gives 0.623, which is only +0.009 and is a timing-like correction.

Misses show no systematic error class. Over-prediction at GO across the other previous-trial cells is uniform and small (-0.13, the intercept offset). The worst windows are whole windows where the feature stays off despite a run of 'a2 S1 u' trials, plus window-edge steps where the previous trial is unknown ('?'). No observed cue I tested predicts the off windows, consistent with the explanation.
The short form sits near the 'all observed' ceiling of 0.66 (0.614 versus 0.66). It is a real description, not curve fitting: an indicator plus one belief-scaled modulation inside that context.
